results.name: P1-1 [defect] A -> off-screen C, Escape: focus returns to C, and C is brought into view by exactly one close-time correction (nearest edge, instant); nothing scrolled while the viewer was open
P1-2 C already visible: focus returns to C and the page does not scroll
P1-3 C removed before close: focus returns to the original opener A (no unrelated card); A is visible, so no scroll
P1-4 C and A both unavailable: the existing fallback behaviour stays safe - no card receives focus, nothing scrolls, close completes
